# Keep an open draft notice consistent when its recovery setting changes

## What & Why
Changing the preference currently affects drafts dismissed afterward. Decide and implement the user-facing behavior for a notice that is already visible when the recovery setting changes, so its displayed countdown and actual deadline never surprise the user.

## Done looks like
- The behavior for already-visible answer and opportunity notices is explicit.
- The countdown and expiration deadline stay consistent with that behavior.
- The behavior is covered by browser tests.
